send.title: Wake machines
send.description: Wake a host from the Power tab, its menu or an automation.

shutdown.title: Shut down machines
shutdown.description: Shut down a host or put it to sleep.

scan.title: Scan networks
scan.description: Look for machines from an SSH host you can connect to.

serverCommands.title: Use the Termix server
serverCommands.description: Save commands that run on the Termix server, and scan from it. This can run anything the server can.

enable.label: Power
enable.description: Show this host on the Power tab.

macAddress.label: MAC address
macAddress.description: The MAC address of the network port that wakes this host.

broadcastAddress.label: Broadcast address
broadcastAddress.description: The subnet broadcast address to send the packet to. Leave blank for 255.255.255.255.

statusInterval.label: Status check interval
statusInterval.description: Seconds between status checks. Checks through a relay host use SSH each time.

allowServerCommands.label: Allow commands on the Termix server
allowServerCommands.description: Let saved ping, wake and shutdown commands run on the Termix server. Only users with the Use the Termix server permission can save them.

plugin.name: Wake-on-LAN
plugin.description: Wake, shut down and track your machines from one power dashboard.

card.title: Power
card.empty: No machines yet. Open the Power tab to add one or scan your network.

tab.title: Power
tab.emptyHint: Add a machine, or scan your network to find them.

failed.shutdown: Failed to shut down this machine
failed.sleep: Failed to put this machine to sleep

device.title: Machine
device.name: Name
device.lanIpHint: The address on the machine's own network, if it differs from the host's address.
device.netmaskHint: Used to work out the broadcast address.
device.linkHint: Makes the name clickable, like a link to a dashboard.
device.autoOpenHint: Opens the link once the machine is online.
device.statusFromHint: Use an SSH host on the same network when Termix can't reach the machine.
device.portsHint: Open ports show on the card. The Termix server only checks ports, so add one the machine answers on.
device.pingCommandHint: Optional. Exit code 0 means the machine is on. {{ip}} and {{mac}} are filled in.
device.wakeFromHint: The packet has to start on the machine's own network. Pick an SSH host there if Termix isn't.
device.broadcastHint: Leave blank to work it out from the LAN IP and netmask.
device.secureOnHint: Optional. 4 or 6 characters, or a value written like a MAC address.
device.timeoutHint: How long to wait before marking it as not responding.
device.cronHint: Optional. Five fields, in the server's time zone.
device.shutdownSshHint: Needs root or passwordless sudo on Linux and macOS.
device.commandTargetHint: Commands run with the login of the person who saved them.
device.solHint: Needs the Sleep-On-LAN tool on the machine with an HTTP listener.
device.testShutdownConfirm: This runs the real command and may shut down {{name}}. Continue?

add.title: Add machine
add.hostHint: If this machine is already a host, pick it so it doesn't show up twice. Its address stays as it is.

scan.title: Scan network
scan.fromHint: Pick an SSH host on that network. It uses nmap if it has it, or else ping.
scan.rangeHint: Leave blank for that host's own private networks.
scan.rangeNeeded: Needed when scanning from the Termix server.
scan.note: A scan finds machines on the network. It can't tell if Wake-on-LAN is turned on for them.

hint.bridge: Almost nothing was found. A Termix container on a bridge network can't see your LAN, so scan from an SSH host instead.
hint.no-mac: Some machines have no MAC. Run the scan with nmap as root, or check the host can see them.

widget.name: Power
widget.description: Machines with their status and power buttons.
widget.pick: Machines to show. Pick none to show all.
